_readme: AUTHOR NOTE (2026-09-23): the lobby Community Board (GRVTV 2.0) reads this file into its dock ticker, two lines at a time and never with an ellipsis, so keep an item that should play there to 40 words or fewer (title + body); longer items are split into pages. Only audience "all" items play on the patient-facing lobby: audience "staff" and "it" are excluded there by the board itself, whatever pages[] says. No PHI, no patient names, ever.

announcements.title: IT Security
announcements.body: Phishing emails and fake 'IT support' calls are circulating. Never share your password or MFA code. Verify any IT caller through the Support Desk before acting. When in doubt, contact IT first.
